rules.en: These pairs are fixed. Every translation uses exactly these words. Never pair 'deducible' with cubrir, eliminar, rebajar, pagar or regalar (Neb. 44-8604). Say 'registered' contractor, never 'licensed'.
rules.es: Estas parejas son fijas. Cada traducción usa exactamente estas palabras. Nunca junte 'deducible' con cubrir, eliminar, rebajar, pagar o regalar (Neb. 44-8604). Diga contratista 'registrado', nunca 'licenciado'.

The homeowner pays it. Never say cubrir, eliminar, rebajar, pagar or regalar near this word (44-8604). Deductible sentences come only from the fixed notice.

Also propietario (more formal).
Building permit = permiso de construcción.
Metal strip at the roof edge that sheds water into the gutter.
Sticky membrane at eaves and valleys; many crews just say 'ice and water'.
The roof boards (OSB/plywood) under the underlayment; also 'tablas del techo'.
Shingles that cover the roof peak; also 'cumbrera'.
First row of shingles (or siding starter) at the bottom edge.
Where two roof slopes meet in a V; crews often say 'valle'.
Roof or wall vent; soft metal that shows hail dents.
Soft spot on a shingle where hail cracked the mat; press it to feel it.
Shingle granules knocked off; a hail sign when it's in fresh round spots.
Trim that holds siding ends around windows and doors; also 'moldura J'.
Wrap under the siding (Tyvek); crews often just say 'house wrap' or 'Tyvek'.
Horizontal boards that overlap (e.g. James Hardie lap).
Also 'calafateo'; 'masilla' in some countries.

Overhead electric line; keep ladders and metal away.
